# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 08-review (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 08-review uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 03_Elasticsearch 05_Kafka 07_Elastic_APM.
# 08-review is a search/review service, so it wires BOTH Elasticsearch instances:
#   - block 07_Elastic_APM `elasticsearch` (:9200) = the application LOG SINK (logs-app-08-review-*)
#   - block 03_Elasticsearch (:9201)              = the business review-SEARCH store (dokandar-reviews)
#
# 08-review is VERIFY-ONLY: it does NOT mint JWT keys. Paste 01-auth's rendered
# JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 + INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the ### Auth_Identity block below
# (from 01-auth's env/.env.dev). If left as placeholders, init-env.sh falls back to
# AUTH_ENV_FILE auto-discovery (/opt/dokandar/01-auth/env/.env.dev).

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 03_Elasticsearch
   endpoint       http://<user>:<password>@<host>:9201
   host:port      <host>:9201
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092
   ui             http://<host>:8080
   auth           none (PLAINTEXT)

### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<elastic-pass>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <elastic-pass>
   kibana_system  <kibana-system-pass>

### Auth_Identity        # paste from 01-auth's rendered env/.env.dev (08-review is verify-only; it NEVER mints keys)
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
